name: tree-table
title: TreeTable
description: Hierarchy WITH columns: a bill of materials, an org rollup, a folder tree with size and owner. `<Tree>` is the same hierarchy with one column of labels, and `<Table>` is the same columns with no nesting. The ARIA pattern is `treegrid`, and it is a contract: the rows are the widget's stops, Right opens a branch or steps into it, Left closes it or steps out, and the whole thing is one tab stop. Copy
